project_overview: Telegram custodial crypto wallet + merchant payment gateway. Includes a Telegram Mini App (/app) for users/merchants and a Web Admin Panel (/admin) for platform operators. UI Language: Russian.
theme: Dark Mode Default (Respects Telegram Mini App environment). Optional Light Mode toggle for Admin Panel.

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings. Use Unbounded for a bold, crypto/Web3 aesthetic. Keep line-height tight (leading-none).

body.instruction: Ensure high legibility for financial data. Use tabular-nums for wallet balances and transaction amounts.

background.instruction: Deepest void black or dark slate. Never pure #000000 without texture. Tinted grey for cards.

colors.contrast_rules: Maintain WCAG AA (4.5:1). Ensure neon accents are readable against dark backgrounds. Use text-shadow if overlaid on complex backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant) for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10. NO FULLY TRANSPARENT HEADERS.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes or 2px inner glow highlights. Use The Tracing Beam effect for high-tier checks or premium referral cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows. Rely on border contrast in dark mode.

grids_and_layouts.mini_app: Mobile-first list architecture. Generous vertical spacing (gap-6 or gap-8 between sections). Sticky bottom action bars for primary actions (Deposit/Withdraw).
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (Bento style). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4). Cardless or 1px sharp borders. Keep tables compact but readable.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use Tailwind scale generously. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 (padding) to avoid text collision.

components.customization_instructions: Strip 'Vercel-look' from shadcn. Make buttons pill-shaped or sharp-edged. Override shadcn Tabs height 'h-9' to 'h-auto'. Never use native <input type='date'> or <select>.

icons.instruction: Use Phosphor icons for a sharp, high-end technical aesthetic. Use Duotone weight for marketing sections, Regular/Bold for functional UI.

motion.transitions: Add transitions for specific interactive elements (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color brighten, or background lightness shift. Always explicitly set text color on hover.
motion.micro_interactions: Entrance staggered animations for list items (transactions, checks). Active press states scale-95 for buttons.

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliance. Text below 18px needs 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='withdraw-submit-button', data-testid='wallet-balance-ton').

image_urls.description: Functional app, heavily UI driven. Abstract 3D objects can be used for empty states if needed, but not strictly required. Rely on typography and layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Develop two distinct areas: Mini App routing under /app (mobile view optimized, fits within Telegram webview) and Admin Panel under /admin (desktop view optimized).
UI Language must be Russian as requested. Hardcode or use simple dictionary for Russian translations.
For the Wallet Mini App: Prioritize large, legible balances (use tabular-nums). Action buttons (Deposit, Withdraw, Transfer) must be prominent.
For the Checks feature: Build an intuitive form with conditions (password, channel sub, captcha, expiry).
For the Admin panel: Use dense data tables, clear status badges (AML flags, freeze, pending), and an overarching stats dashboard.
DO NOT apply `.App { text-align: center; }`. Left-align text for readability.
Never use generic placeholder text or dummy image APIs. If an icon is needed, use Phosphor.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, press, staggered entrance). Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize reusing existing components from src/components/ui. Create matching ones when needed.
